prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval low-magic RPG pixel-art character review board, TWO ROWS by TWO COLUMNS on neutral flat grey, no text. Each row one adult front three-quarter and back three-quarter. Top TAORI, an adult woman industrial-injury patient with ordinary continuing care needs: mature tired face, dark hair loosely tied, worn muted mauve-brown wool dress, linen shawl, simple shoes, seated upright on one small plain wooden stool in both views, hands resting naturally on a folded blanket on her knees. Do NOT invent specific amputation, wound, deformity, blood or visible injury diagnosis; fatigue is restrained, not abject. Bottom HASE, independent medicine-marketing agent, not a canonical pharmacist: well-kept middle-aged man with short dark beard, plain muted olive coat, brown waistcoat, modest business satchel, holds one small CLOSED ordinary amber bottle with blank unmarked paper label; courteous neutral posture, free hand down. No bottle is given to patient; no treatment, medical trial, cure, payment, signature, testimonial, endorsement or agreement. Isolated character studies only. Proposed appearance is not narrative canon. Crisp coarse pixel clusters with strong silhouette-first top-down-oblique game proportions, limited earthy colors, wool/leather textures simplified, no smooth portrait painting or glossy realistic shading. No red cross or modern medical symbol, no magic aura, no text/labels/numbers, no room background, no religious or royal marks. Not a certified pixel grid or runtime animation.
